findings.summary: The connector has no modified-UTF-7 encoder.
findings.evidence: packages/connector-imap/src/imap/utf7.ts exports only decodeModifiedUtf7; grep of packages/connector-imap found no encodeModifiedUtf7.
findings.invariant: Read-only IMAP stores LIST wires and reuses them for EXAMINE and cursor keys (mailbox.ts:148-221, sign-in.ts:130-147).
findings.required_fix: None for production. P057/P058 may keep the draft encoder as a test helper; do not add a product encoder unless a later packet creates mailboxes.

findings.summary: Seven legitimate decode vectors already exist; do not duplicate them as decode-only tests.
findings.required_fix: Reuse those rows for round-trip only; add the ten new corpus ids.

findings.summary: folderLabel and sign-in/mailbox walks never exercise an international wire in tests.
findings.evidence: No test imports folderLabel. mailbox.test.ts uses INBOX/Archive. Fixture wire &AOk-quipe at testing/index.ts:75 is \Noselect and skipped by list().
findings.required_fix: Optional later: one LIST/sign-in fixture using a corpus wire. Out of R059 (encoding round-trip only).

downstream_handoff.add: Table-driven round trip: encode(display)===wire and decode(wire)===display for all 17 ids, or at least the 10 new ids plus round-trip on the 7 existing vectors.
